Genuine bug still unfixed upstream. v1.17.9 moved the duration() implementation: packages/opencode/src/util/locale.ts is now just `export * from "@opencode-ai/tui/util/locale"`, and the real code lives in packages/tui/src/util/locale.ts. That upstream copy STILL has the swapped/broken days-hours math: `const hours = Math.floor(input / 3600000)` (total hours, not remainder) and `const days = Math.floor((input % 3600000) / 86400000)` (always 0 because input%3600000 < 3600000 << 86400000). Our fix is correct: days = floor(input/86400000), hours = floor((input%86400000)/3600000). MERGE NOTE: keep the fix, but re-apply it at the new location packages/tui/src/util/locale.ts since the opencode-package copy collapses to a re-export upstream.
